proposed_spec.title: Blob containers have an effective default retention policy
proposed_spec.description: Reads each container and its account or container default policy to check whether new writes inherit a positive retention period. Unlocked policies satisfy this configuration check but can still be changed.
proposed_spec.remediation_hint: Configure a default retention period for containers without one. Lock the policy when retention must not be shortened or removed.
